ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Low-intensity (black) pixels comprise approximately 70% of the visible surface, with high-intensity (white) pixels comprising approximately 30% concentrated in the distal regions.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant black region occupies the central 60% of the fluke. Contiguous white patches are located at the left and right distal tips. Extensive mottled stippling (white-on-black) exists at the interfaces between the solid black center and the white tips.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped central depression with an estimated vertex angle of 50 degrees and a depth reaching approximately 15% of the total vertical fluke span.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Extremely high-frequency serration pattern. Multiple sharp, irregular peaks and deep valleys are distributed along the entire trailing edge of both lobes. Significant pointed protrusions are visible on the inner-middle sections of both lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Strong concave upward curve (U-shaped profile) with both distal tips oriented towards the top of the frame.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Dense, brownish/tan textured clusters are present at the extreme tips of both flukes. Numerous white punctate spots are distributed throughout the black pigmented regions.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Prominent barnacle colonies visible as high-contrast, brownish-yellow textured masses at the left and right distal tips.
other_distinctive_markers: The trailing edge exhibits an exceptionally irregular, jagged silhouette with several prominent triangular teeth-like projections.
